songs.title: Where Can You Buy It? 🛍️
lines: Where can you buy a teddy bear,
a teddy bear, a teddy bear?
You can buy a teddy bear
at the toy store in town!
I need to buy some medicine,
n: 곡조: The Muffin Man (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
질문 줄에서는 손을 이마에 대고 두리번거리고, 대답 줄에서는 가게 쪽을 손가락으로 가리켜요. 다른 물건·가게로 바꿔 불러도 좋아요.
songs.imgPrompt: Children walking down a colorful town street past a toy store with a teddy bear in the window and a pharmacy next door.

songs.title: Cheap or Expensive? 🖊️
lines: a pen and lots of crayons.
How much is the little pen?
It's cheap, so I can buy it!
How much is the fountain pen?
I want it, but I can't buy it.
I'm happy with my cheap one!
n: 곡조: Yankee Doodle (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
'cheap'에서는 엄지 척, 'expensive'에서는 두 손으로 볼을 감싸며 깜짝 놀라는 표정을 지어요.
songs.imgPrompt: A child at a stationery store counter holding a small pen happily while looking with wide eyes at a shiny fountain pen in a glass case.
